## List All Accounts for an Identity in ISC

Use the **List Accounts** endpoint with a filter on `identityId`:

```http
GET /v3/accounts?filters=identityId eq "{id}"
```

### Example (curl)

```bash
IDENTITY_ID="2c9180835d2e5168015d32f890ca1581"

curl -X GET \
  "https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/accounts?filters=identityId%20eq%20%22${IDENTITY_ID}%22" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {access_token}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json"
```

### Key Response Fields

Each account object returned includes:

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `id` | Account ID |
| `name` | Account name on the source |
| `sourceId` | ID of the connected source |
| `sourceName` | Human-readable source name |
| `identityId` | The identity this account is linked to |
| `attributes` | Source-specific account attributes |
| `disabled` | Whether the account is disabled |
| `locked` | Whether the account is locked |

### Optional Query Parameters

- **`limit`** / **`offset`** — pagination (default limit is 250, max 250)
- **`count=true`** — include total count in `X-Total-Count` response header
- **`sorters`** — e.g. `sorters=sourceName` to sort results

### Paginated Example

```bash
curl -X GET \
  "https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/accounts\
?filters=identityId%20eq%20%22${IDENTITY_ID}%22\
&limit=250&offset=0&count=true" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {access_token}"
```

---

```answer-summary
endpoints:
  - method: GET
    path: /v3/accounts
    api_version: v3
auth_flow: OAuth2 bearer token
required_scopes: [idn:accounts:read]
key_parameters: [filters, limit, offset, count]
```
